name: Eustace
source:
Role: Sacristan 
I am not sure what to make of my colleague. Her flat affect makes it difficult to understand what she really thinks. [Spoiler]We do not share the same sense of humor, and she can be cruel. But... so can I, I am discovering. And Eustace is very forgiving. She knows something I do not. I am worried what that might be.[/spoiler] 

[Edited from the in-game description]
